oneOf.title: UNIFORM
oneOf.description: Select completely random numbers whithin avg-var until avg+var

oneOf.title: TRIANGLE
oneOf.description: Select random numbers with numbers near avg being the most commonly selected ones, following a triangle curve

oneOf.title: GAUSSIAN
oneOf.description: Select random numbers with numbers near avg being the more commonly selected ones, following a gaussian curve

oneOf.title: NARROWGAUSSIAN
oneOf.description: Select random numbers with numbers near avg being the much more commonly selected ones, following a narrow gaussian curve

oneOf.title: VERYNARROWGAUSSIAN
oneOf.description: Select random numbers with numbers near avg being the much much more commonly selected ones, following an even narrower gaussian curve

oneOf.title: NARROWINVERSEGAUSSIAN
oneOf.description: Select random numbers with numbers near avg being the much less commonly selected ones, following an upside down gaussian curve

oneOf.title: INVEXP
oneOf.description: Select random numbers in the form of avg + var, with numbers near avg being preferred

oneOf.title: STRONGINVEXP
oneOf.description: Select random numbers in the form of avg + var, with numbers near avg being strongly preferred

oneOf.title: STRONGERINVEXP
oneOf.description: Select random numbers in the form of avg + var, with numbers near avg being very strongly preferred

oneOf.title: DIRAC
oneOf.description: Select completely random numbers within avg-var until avg+var only ONCE and then always 0
